title: Great free app
body: Has all the functionality you need. But, if theres one thing I could improve it would be the widget - I’d like a widget that allows me to see all my habits and their progress and allows me to check them off.
author: cali90210la

title: Great app
body: I love it. The free version is great, it has the basics down and it’s perfect as just a habit tracker. The premium is good, the price isn’t too much even for my country, so I’ll get it. Overall great!
author: Nikola2K
